Priya: FYI — scheduled cross-region maintenance and staggered canary failover tonight 03:00-04:30 UTC. Targets: west-1 -> central-1 -> east-1. Purpose: kernel upgrade + pod eviction dry-run + a small capacity rebalance.
Alex: Noted. What's the SLO impact window?
Priya: We'll temporarily relax the P99 latency SLO from 200ms -> 280ms for the 90m window. Endpoint-level SLOs for /v1/generate will get a 15% concurrency soft cap during the canary steps.
Maria: Added runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cross-region-canary. Please follow the checklist under "staggered failover".
SRE-Bot: Ticket RI-2025-142 created for this maintenance. Pager schedule attached.
Sam: Who's primary oncall for the window?
Oncall Rotation: Priya primary, Alex secondary, Sam tertiary. Night backup: Lee (standby).
Lee: I'll watch qps and eviction logs. DM me if we see >5% tail increase.
Priya: Canary steps (short):
1) west-1: drain 2 nodes in pool-a, validate KV cache warmup (~10m)
2) central-1: drain 4 nodes in pool-b, run 10m loadtest at 40% baseline
3) east-1: soft-drain 6 nodes, check autoscaler and fallback routing
Please allow 15-20m between steps to observe metrics.
Alex: Put the exact kubectl drain command in chat?
Priya: Sure — use this (run from controlplane-bastion):
```
kubectl drain node/<node-name> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
```
And then: `curl -s https://observability/api/v1/query?query=p99_latency` to check p99.
Maria: We'll run a short internal loadtest after step 2 to validate routing: `rload --target /v1/generate --qps 200 --duration 600s --keys sample-prompts.json`
Sam: What is rollback criteria?
Priya: Rollback if any of:
- sustained P99 > 350ms for >5m
- error rate spike >0.5% absolute
- KV cache miss ratio >10% after 20m of warmup
If triggered, revert draining and route traffic back to previous AZ; notify product and infra leads.
Lee: Noted. How do we revert routing? Is it manual or scripted?
Priya: We have an automated fallback script but will do manual confirmation: `scripts/failover/revert_region_traffic.sh <region>` — will run only after consensus.
SRE-Bot: Deploy-bot note: a non-disruptive kernel update will land on nodes in west-1 at 03:15 UTC. No immediate restart scheduled.
Alex: Any expected consumer-facing notices? Product?
Priya: Small notice on status page during the window. No planned customer-facing downtime. I'll post the status update 15m before start.
Maria: Ops: tagging checklist items — I've assigned KV cache pre-warm tasks to "cache-team".
Sam: I'll run a smoke test script post-step verifying sample prompts and tokenization parity.
Priya: Quick reminder: disable autoscaler burst for pool-a during step 1 to avoid noisy autoscale. Command: `kubectl patch hpa pool-a -p '{"spec": {"minReplicas": 2, "maxReplicas": 10}}'` (restore after step).
Lee: Logged a note to run correlation on model-variant fallbacks — rare but good to watch.
Oncall Rotation: Calendar invites sent to rotation and product on-call.
Maria: Adding a small synthetic monitor: `synthetic/region-failover-check` to run every 30s for the window.
Priya: If you see anything weird ping #eng-oncall and @Oncall Rotation. Keep messages short and include metric snippets.
Sam: Acknowledged. I'll be available 02:45->05:00 UTC.
Alex: I'll take post-mortem doc draft after the window. Template: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/template
Priya: Thanks all. Let's meet 05:15 UTC for a 20m quick sync. :pumpkin:
SRE-Bot: Maintenance reminder: 15 minutes until start.
Maria: copy that.
Alex: :thumbsup:
Sam: :white_check_mark:
Lee: see you in 3h.
